name: Cora Brant
source_profile:
Cora Brant (LN) — Proprietor and Managing Partner

Cora is an ambitious southern noblewoman whose family accumulated considerable wealth through livestock breeding and agricultural estates. She regards the eastern frontier as an opportunity to establish a commercial dynasty rivaling the oldest landed houses of Cador. A disciplined and practical businesswoman, she maintains close relationships with several influential nobles, although her efforts to secure ever-larger grazing concessions have made her unpopular among independent ranchers.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 44 (source excerpt; may be partial)
